messages:
Alex: Quick async check-in for the sprint — TL;DR: focusing on roadmap cleanup + launch prep.
Priya: What did you pick up yesterday?
Alex: Yesterday: finished the spec pass for routing tier fallbacks, opened PR #4287, added TODOs for the docs. Blocker: still waiting on infra to confirm compatible quantized model shard configs.
Samir: PR #4287 looks good overall. left 2 small nits. can review tomorrow morning.
Jordan: Heads up — infra confirmed the quantized shard profiles will land today, but there may be a config rename. I added a note in the infra ticket.
Alex: Thanks @Jordan. If the rename sticks we'll need a quick conversion script. putting a spike on my board for 2h today.
Priya: Today: I'll finish the rollout plan for beta customers (canaries + metrics) and wireup the eval prompt set. Need a quick check: do we want per-route throttles in beta or just global?
Samir: I'd vote global for beta to reduce variables. We can add per-route in dedicated later.
Jordan: Agree with Samir. global throttles simplify SLOs for the first pass.
Alex: OK global for beta. Priya, on the evals — add the latency-sensitive prompts to the smoke list (seq length ~2k).
Priya: Will do. Also pinging @Samir for a quick CR on the canary dashboard widget: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/merge_requests/112
Samir: on it. I can carve out 30m after lunch.
deploy-bot: NOTE: Staging deploy scheduled at 16:00 UTC — includes infra config update for quantized shards.
Alex: Good to know. I'll hold off merging the routing PR until after the staging deploy completes and we run the smoke tests.
Jordan: I'll monitor the deploy and push any renames to a temp branch if needed.
Priya: Blockers: none critical, just waiting on the staging run for final signoff.
Samir: Blockers: found a flaky e2e in the embedding cache flow, investigating — might need a short hotfix.
Alex: Thanks. If it's >=2hrs blocker ping me and I can re-prioritize. Otherwise we'll keep the rollout timeline.
Priya: Small ops ask — can someone update the release notes template with a "beta considerations" section? saves us time during handoff.
Samir: I'll add that in a quick PR.
Alex: Great. Anything else?
Jordan: Nothing from infra beyond the deploy watch.
Priya: All good.
Alex: Cool — will post a concise checklist after staging smoke. :thumbsup:
